question: How many employees work at the company?
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS employee_count FROM humanresources.employee

question: How many employees are currently assigned to each department?
expected_sql: SELECT d.name AS department, COUNT(*) AS employee_count FROM humanresources.employeedepartmenthistory AS h JOIN humanresources.department AS d ON h.departmentid = d.departmentid WHERE h.enddate IS NULL GROUP BY d.name ORDER BY employee_count DESC

question: List each employee's first name, last name, and job title.
expected_sql: SELECT p.firstname, p.lastname, e.jobtitle FROM humanresources.employee AS e JOIN person.person AS p ON e.businessentityid = p.businessentityid ORDER BY p.lastname, p.firstname

question: How many employees are salaried (not hourly)?
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS salaried_count FROM humanresources.employee WHERE salariedflag = TRUE

question: What is the average number of vacation hours per department for currently assigned employees?
expected_sql: SELECT d.name AS department, AVG(e.vacationhours) AS avg_vacation_hours FROM humanresources.employee AS e JOIN humanresources.employeedepartmenthistory AS h ON e.businessentityid = h.businessentityid JOIN humanresources.department AS d ON h.departmentid = d.departmentid WHERE h.enddate IS NULL GROUP BY d.name ORDER BY avg_vacation_hours DESC

question: How many products are there in each product category?
expected_sql: SELECT c.name AS category, COUNT(*) AS product_count FROM production.product AS p JOIN production.productsubcategory AS s ON p.productsubcategoryid = s.productsubcategoryid JOIN production.productcategory AS c ON s.productcategoryid = c.productcategoryid GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY product_count DESC

question: What are the five most expensive products by list price?
expected_sql: SELECT name, listprice FROM production.product ORDER BY listprice DESC LIMIT 5

question: How many products have no product subcategory assigned?
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS products_without_subcategory FROM production.product WHERE productsubcategoryid IS NULL

question: Which ten customers have placed the most sales orders?
expected_sql: SELECT c.customerid, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM sales.salesorderheader AS o JOIN sales.customer AS c ON o.customerid = c.customerid GROUP BY c.customerid ORDER BY order_count DESC LIMIT 10

question: What is the total sales revenue booked in each territory?
expected_sql: SELECT t.name AS territory, SUM(o.subtotal) AS total_revenue FROM sales.salesorderheader AS o JOIN sales.salesterritory AS t ON o.territoryid = t.territoryid GROUP BY t.name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC

question: What are the ten products with the highest total quantity sold?
expected_sql: SELECT p.name AS product, SUM(d.orderqty) AS total_sold FROM sales.salesorderdetail AS d JOIN production.product AS p ON d.productid = p.productid GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY total_sold DESC LIMIT 10

question: What is the average sales-order subtotal?
expected_sql: SELECT AVG(subtotal) AS avg_order_subtotal FROM sales.salesorderheader

question: How many sales orders were placed online versus in-store?
expected_sql: SELECT onlineorderflag, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM sales.salesorderheader GROUP BY onlineorderflag

question: How many customers have never placed a sales order?
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers_without_orders FROM sales.customer AS c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sales.salesorderheader AS o WHERE o.customerid = c.customerid)

question: List each vendor and the number of purchase orders issued to them.
expected_sql: SELECT v.name AS vendor, COUNT(*) AS purchase_orders FROM purchasing.purchaseorderheader AS h JOIN purchasing.vendor AS v ON h.vendorid = v.businessentityid GROUP BY v.name ORDER BY purchase_orders DESC

question: What is the total purchase-order spend per vendor?
expected_sql: SELECT v.name AS vendor, SUM(h.subtotal) AS total_spend FROM purchasing.purchaseorderheader AS h JOIN purchasing.vendor AS v ON h.vendorid = v.businessentityid GROUP BY v.name ORDER BY total_spend DESC

question: For each product, how many purchase-order line items reference it?
expected_sql: SELECT p.name AS product, COUNT(*) AS po_line_items FROM purchasing.purchaseorderdetail AS d JOIN production.product AS p ON d.productid = p.productid GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY po_line_items DESC

question: How many employees were hired in each calendar year?
expected_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM hiredate)::int AS hire_year, COUNT(*) AS hired FROM humanresources.employee GROUP BY hire_year ORDER BY hire_year

question: How many sales orders have a subtotal greater than 10000?
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS large_orders FROM sales.salesorderheader WHERE subtotal > 10000

question: Within each product category, rank products by list price from highest to lowest.
expected_sql: SELECT c.name AS category, p.name AS product, p.listprice, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.name ORDER BY p.listprice DESC) AS price_rank FROM production.product AS p JOIN production.productsubcategory AS s ON p.productsubcategoryid = s.productsubcategoryid JOIN production.productcategory AS c ON s.productcategoryid = c.productcategoryid

question: How many employees currently have no active department assignment?
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS unassigned FROM humanresources.employee AS e WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM humanresources.employeedepartmenthistory AS h WHERE h.businessentityid = e.businessentityid AND h.enddate IS NULL)

question: Among sales-order line items that have a discount, what is the average discount fraction?
expected_sql: SELECT AVG(unitpricediscount) AS avg_discount FROM sales.salesorderdetail WHERE unitpricediscount > 0
